title: Reminder email the evening before a watering shift
summary: A scheduled email in an app that runs several web instances and one worker.

turns.text: Members keep forgetting their watering shifts. Can you send each member a reminder email the evening before their shift?

Two things decide where this job goes: how many instances of the app run, and which job runner the repo already has. A timer inside a process that runs more than once sends more than one email. I'll check the deploy config and the existing jobs first.

turns.excerpt:
services:
  web:
    command: node dist/server.js
    replicas: 3
  worker:
    command: node dist/worker.js
    replicas: 1

files.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+ALTER TABLE shifts ADD COLUMN reminder_sent_at timestamptz;

> garden-plots@1.4.0 test

turns.text:
Members now get one reminder email at 18:00 garden time, the evening before their shift.

Where it runs: deploy/app.yaml runs 3 web replicas and 1 worker (t3), so the job is a BullMQ job scheduler on the worker, next to the existing cleanup job (t4). A timer in the web server would fire three times.

No duplicates: each shift is stamped with reminder_sent_at before its email goes out, so a retry or a second run sends nothing twice. The trade-off is that if the worker dies between the stamp and the send, that one email is skipped rather than sent twice. Cancelled shifts are skipped.

The three new tests pass with the rest of the suite (t8).

Before you deploy, run migration 0012, which adds shifts.reminder_sent_at. The job fails without it.

One choice is yours: I picked 18:00 in the garden's timezone. Tell me if you want a different hour.
Members keep forgetting their watering shifts. Can you send each member a reminder email the evening before their shift?
I'll add a cron job that emails members the day before their shift.
